concepts.name: Convergent boundary
concepts.definition: Boundary where two plates move toward each other, so crust is consumed by subduction or crumpled upward by collision.

concepts.name: Divergent boundary
concepts.definition: Boundary where two plates move apart and magma rises to create new crust, forming rifts on land and ridges at sea.

concepts.name: Transform boundary
concepts.definition: Boundary where two plates slide horizontally past each other, so crust is neither created nor destroyed.
